change: Replace launch-command presentation with a working recorded-run dashboard; add metrics and charts to the local live monitor.
tested_revision: Dashboard v1; exact source identities are the SHA-256 entries below.

evidence.classification: Two frozen Study 01 failures and one previously recorded integration check; not a new research comparison.

checks.name: Source provenance and accounting
checks.detail: Source SHA-256 values, individual token sums, tool-error counts, measured wall-time sums and summary counts match all three archived runs. Export generator also verifies frozen cards against the already-published failure record.

checks.name: Export parity and field allowlist
checks.detail: Downloadable JSON and embedded JavaScript data are equal. Private request, response, credential and reasoning fields are absent.

checks.name: JavaScript and local assets
checks.detail: Four scripts pass node --check. Relative source/download links exist, HTML IDs are unique, the page contains no preformatted command blocks, and dashboard assets return HTTP 200.

checks.name: Hosted dashboard interactions
checks.detail: Browser selected all three runs and confirmed 53,735 / 20,067 / 121,015 tokens. Per-call/cumulative switch, call selection and error filter work; two integration errors and empty-error state on the route run are displayed. Frozen graph absence is explicit.

checks.name: Desktop, mobile and theme
checks.detail: Visual inspection at the normal desktop viewport and 390 px width. No horizontal page overflow. Dark/light modes and both numeric charts rendered. Directed graph arrowheads repaired after review. Browser error log empty.

checks.name: Local monitor dashboard
checks.detail: Read-only server on temporary port 8781 displayed archived integration run: 11 calls, 53,735 tokens, 2,872 ms mean, 12 receipts and 2 returned problems. Cumulative toggle and pause/resume worked. At 390 px, no horizontal overflow. All raw diagnostics remain inside closed details by default. Browser error log empty.

checks.name: Local chart boundary checks
checks.detail: In-memory frontend checks covered unavailable records, pending zero defaults, completed-token total, duration mean, cumulative values, error classification and CSP-compatible tool bars.

repairs_during_validation: Fixed directed graph endpoints that initially hid arrowheads behind nodes, and separated opposite-direction edges.
Local tool bars use SVG attributes to comply with the monitor Content-Security-Policy.
limitations: Hosted charts are archived snapshots. New local runs are not uploaded or synchronized automatically.
Local port 8766 did not answer its health check in this session. UI validation used a separate read-only server on port 8781; the existing process was not modified.
No new live model run, live-traffic test, real ASR test, assistance-quality evaluation or user study was performed.
Two frozen runs did not save execution graphs. No graph was reconstructed for them.
The local backend normalizes missing completed usage to zero without an availability flag; recorded tokens are not billing totals. Pending values are excluded.
Local charts display at most the latest 80 model-call records while KPI totals use all returned records.
